rules._note: Perk-coin rank-up costs, legendary perk slot levels and the Legendary SPECIAL bonuses are NOT kept here: build_builds_json.py reads them from the game records (CURV LegendaryPerks_Upgrades, CURV LegendaryPerkSlotCount, SPEL AbLgnPerk<Stat>) every build. specialStart / specialCap / pointsCapLevel are the character-sheet rules (1 point in each SPECIAL at the start, 15 max, one point per level to 50).

focus._note: How much each playstyle wants each tag. A card / effect / mod scores the sum of the weights of its tags. Weapon-class tags (heavy, rifle, melee...) are handled separately: a card tagged for a weapon class you don't use is never picked.

statValue._note: Value of one raw SPECIAL point on its own (before any card sits on it), per tag the build wants. Keeps spare points going to the stat that helps most.
